summary: Observer and subscription details read only the requested item in one SQLite snapshot.

schema.detail: No database schema or index change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule or retention change.

compatibility.detail: Raw-ID-first/prefixed fallback, scope admission, wrong-kind/missing 404 and stopped details are preserved. Item and envelope now use one pinned cut. Detail keys are limited to 4 KiB; cumulative selected source payload/metadata to 256 KiB; rendered item plus snapshot to 512 KiB. Oversize returns non-retryable projection-detail-too-large (HTTP 422), without truncation or list fallback. Invalid stored types, UTF-8, JSON or numeric timestamps return non-retryable projection-detail-invalid-source (HTTP 422), instead of silent null/default decoding. Lists and their cursor behavior are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No restart or interruption beyond ordinary deployment.

recovery.detail: No writer, checkpoint or rollback changes; existing source data is preserved.
